label: MRtrix3 mrfilter
description:
Perform filtering operations on 3D / 4D MR images

The interface exposes the typed options listed below; the original installed-version help is retained in source references.

parameters.label: filter
parameters.description: the type of filter to be applied
parameters.usage: the type of filter to be applied Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: axes
parameters.description: For filters fft: the axes along which to apply the Fourier Transform. By default, the transform is applied along the three spatial axes. Provide as a comma-separate list of axis indices.
parameters.usage: the axes along which to apply the Fourier Transform. By default, the transform is applied along the three spatial axes. Provide as a comma-separate list of axis indices.  Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: inverse
parameters.usage: apply the inverse FFT Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: magnitude
parameters.description: output a magnitude image rather than a complex-valued image
parameters.usage: output a magnitude image rather than a complex-valued image Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: centre_zero
parameters.description: re-arrange the FFT results so that the zero-frequency component appears in the centre of the image, rather than at the edges
parameters.usage: re-arrange the FFT results so that the zero-frequency component appears in the centre of the image, rather than at the edges Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: stdev
parameters.description: For filters gradient, smooth: the standard deviation of the Gaussian kernel used to smooth the input image (in mm). The image is smoothed to reduced large spurious gradients caused by noise. Use this option to override the default stdev of 1 voxel. This can be specified either as a single value to be used for all 3 axes, or as a comma-separated list of 3 values, one for each axis.
parameters.usage: the standard deviation of the Gaussian kernel used to smooth the input image (in mm). The image is smoothed to reduced large spurious gradients caused by noise. Use this option to override the default stdev of 1 voxel. This can be specified either as a single value to be used for all 3 axes, or as a comma-separated list of 3 values, one for each axis.  Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: scanner
parameters.description: define the gradient with respect to the scanner coordinate frame of reference.
parameters.usage: define the gradient with respect to the scanner coordinate frame of reference. Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: extent
parameters.description: For filters median, normalise, smooth: specify extent of median filtering neighbourhood in voxels. This can be specified either as a single value to be used for all 3 axes, or as a comma-separated list of 3 values, one for each axis (default: 3x3x3).
parameters.usage: specify extent of median filtering neighbourhood in voxels. This can be specified either as a single value to be used for all 3 axes, or as a comma-separated list of 3 values, one for each axis (default: 3x3x3).  Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: fwhm
parameters.description: For filters smooth: apply Gaussian smoothing with the specified full-width half maximum. The FWHM is defined in mm (Default 1 voxel * 2.3548). This can be specified either as a single value to be used for all axes, or as a comma-separated list of the FWHM for each axis.
parameters.usage: apply Gaussian smoothing with the specified full-width half maximum. The FWHM is defined in mm (Default 1 voxel * 2.3548). This can be specified either as a single value to be used for all axes, or as a comma-separated list of the FWHM for each axis.  Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: zupper
parameters.description: For filters zclean: define high intensity outliers: default: 2.5
parameters.usage: define high intensity outliers: default: 2.5  Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: zlower
parameters.description: For filters zclean: define low intensity outliers: default: 2.5
parameters.usage: define low intensity outliers: default: 2.5  Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: bridge
parameters.description: For filters zclean: number of voxels to gap to fill holes in mask: default: 4
parameters.usage: number of voxels to gap to fill holes in mask: default: 4  Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: save_maskout
parameters.description: Output a refined mask based on a spatially coherent region with normal intensity range.
parameters.usage: Output a refined mask based on a spatially coherent region with normal intensity range. Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: nthreads
parameters.description: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).
parameters.usage: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).  Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

input_slots.label: maskin
input_slots.description: initial mask that defines the maximum spatial extent and the region from which to smaple the intensity range.

output_slots.label: output
output_slots.description: Native command output, saved in this run’s output directory. Perform filtering operations on 3D / 4D MR images The output meaning depends on the input and selected operation. This generic image port does not certify anatomical labels, diffusion orientation, tissue fractions or spatial alignment.
